schema.title: Response Every Card Api Cards Get
Response Cards Api Techniques  Technique  Cards Get
Response Offered Api Techniques  Technique  Candidates Get
Response Every Problem Api Problems Get

Asked.title: Asked
Asked.description:
One attempt the loop still asks about, and the modes its verdict leaves
open. No mode is offered where the record already answers why.

AttemptClaim.title: AttemptClaim
AttemptClaim.description: Which techniques an attempt used, as one writer claimed them.

AttemptVerification.title: AttemptVerification
AttemptVerification.description: Private to the user, where a solution's run is product data: `log.md`.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description:
A problem offered for a drill. The statement is left out: the clock
starts when it is served.

Card.title: Card
Card.description:
Teaching content for one technique: forms to reproduce, and a
selector.

Failure.title: Failure
Failure.description: The first case a submission failed, shown whole: `flows.md`.

Gap.title: Gap
Gap.description:
A core template no solution displays, named as the card names it.

The card claims to teach the form, so the ladder reports the gap rather
than substituting another problem for the rung. The next generation run is
aimed at what this names.

Hint.title: Hint
Hint.description:
What the trainer gives when memory fails, in the order it gives them.
Each answers more of the question than the last.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: The one mode the solver picked. A skipped label sends no request.

Listed.title: Listed
Listed.description:
One problem on the listing of every served problem. It carries the
problem's techniques, which the page filters by, and no statement.

Picked.title: Picked
Picked.description:
The problem a user picked, before its statement is served. The statement
is left out, as a candidate's is.

Probe.title: Probe
Probe.description:
One problem a run was given, testing whether the form is recognised
unprompted. Drawn from outside the ladder, which teaches the form.

Probed.title: Probed
Probed.description:
One probe the start drew, named as the page shows it. A probe tests
whether the form is recognised unprompted, so the page names the problem
and says nothing of the technique behind it.

Prompted.title: Prompted
Prompted.description:
What the trainer shows: the template's trigger and the signature its
cases call. The title and the form are withheld, and mapping the trigger
to the form is the recall being measured.

Provider.title: Provider
Provider.description: Who holds an identity and its login: `README.md`.

RecallAttempt.title: RecallAttempt
RecallAttempt.description: A form typed into a blank file and run against the template's cases.

Recalled.title: Recalled
Recalled.description:
One template's recall state: the last reproduction of it, and nothing
of the ones before, which stay in the log.

Reproduction.title: Reproduction
Reproduction.description:
What the trainer sends: the form as typed, and the hints taken before
it ran.

Rung.title: Rung
Rung.description:
One problem on a ladder, with the templates its canonicals display.

A rung the selector filled covers none. `required` is derived from what the
rung covers rather than stored, and a rung covering the optional template
beside a core one offers that form as the alternative approach.

Selector.title: Selector
Selector.description:
What a ladder resolves from. Named fields rather than a filter map, so
a new filter is an additive optional field.

SelfLabel.title: SelfLabel
SelfLabel.description: The user's own verdict on why an attempt went the way it did.

Served.title: Served
Served.description:
What a solver is handed: the statement and the clock, and nothing the
problem was written from.

Studied.title: Studied
Studied.description:
A card as its page reads it. The ladder, the progress and the recall
state are folds, and `content.md` gives why none of them is stored.

Submitted.title: Submitted
Submitted.description:
The attempt a submission minted, and the per-case verdict behind its
`solved`.

TechniqueRow.title: TechniqueRow
TechniqueRow.description: One technique's progress, derived from the log on every read.

Template.title: Template
Template.description: One form reproduced from memory. The unit of recall.

TemplateCase.title: TemplateCase
TemplateCase.description:
One case a reproduced form is checked against. The arguments are
positional, and `solve` is the function they call.

Timed.title: Timed
Timed.description:
A sitting a pause, a resume or an end moved, with its elapsed time on the
engine's clock.

Unclaimed.title: Unclaimed
Unclaimed.description:
The claim a sitting ends on: the attempts no claim answers yet with the
modes each one's verdict leaves open, and the problem's techniques they are
answered over.
